Join us at the California Adaptation Forum in Pomona, CA from July 31 to August 2, 2024! We will be hosting a workshop and session, providing valuable insights into the utilization of climate data and tools.

Workshop: Learn to Use Climate Data & Tools for Decision-Making in CA through Cal-Adapt
- Date: July 31st
- Time: 1:00 - 2:45 pm

Session: Actionable Data & Tools to Enable Climate-Informed Decision-Making in California
- Date: August 2nd
- Time: 10:15 - 11:45 am
